frames.subject: One student desk with an open lit laptop and a black stacking chair on the first slab of a stone walk across a dark lawn, a red paver partway up the walk.
frames.visual_consequence: A policy still being drafted outdoors before anyone has arrived, the red paver marking a place further along.
frames.weakness: The pavers are flat extruded slabs with no chipped edges or soil; the chair back carries no edge light.
frames.repair: Real stone on the walk and a thin rim along the chair back.

frames.subject: A field of desks with lit laptops in six aisles receding to the horizon, the hero desk alone in its pool in the lower left, labelled ONE DESK = 1,000 STUDENTS A YEAR.
frames.visual_consequence: 79,000 students a year divided by 1,000 gives 79 desks, a headcount seen as a field.
frames.weakness: Far screens shimmer with moire; instanced desks read as flat planes; a hard horizon line; flat turf right of the label.
frames.repair: A plain emissive or mip-mapped far LOD for the screens, and the stage fog softening the horizon.

frames.subject: The hero desk side-on from a low camera, lid lit, seat empty and lit, standing on the October 12th granite paver, no figure drawn.
frames.visual_consequence: The chair the cover showed waiting is now turned toward the reader on the dated paver, the deck resolving where the cover pointed.
frames.weakness: The red paver is cropped to a sliver at the bottom under the footer; an unlit stepped slab behind is a dead block.
frames.repair: Pull back about 10 percent so the paver and the feet sit above the footer band; push the slab into the fog.
